product.name: ratchet
promise: then keep it from going backwards.
product.lede: Ratchet is a proposed versioned YAML format, a CLI, a preset catalog and assessors for declaring what quality means for a project, how to assess it, and what evidence a candidate must produce before it can advance. A gate returns pass, fail or insufficient evidence; only a pass clears it. Release 0.0.1 ships a ratchet binary that parses the 16 commands and prints its version; no command is built yet, so it checks nothing for a project. The formats and the design are proposals, and presets/ holds the first family of the catalog.
product.description: A proposed YAML format and CLI to declare software quality requirements and refuse regressions. Release 0.0.1 ships a binary that parses the 16 commands; no command is built yet, so it checks nothing for a project.

items.title: Specification
items.description: YAML document shapes, typed comparisons, evidence and gate semantics, and a machine-readable schema for authoring.

items.title: CLI
items.description: Proposed commands include ratchet init, validate, assess, evaluate --gate <name> and reference propose.

items.title: Preset catalog
items.description: Reusable YAML for web, backend, code quality, build and CI concerns. The first family, the functional one, is in presets/; no command resolves a binding yet.

items.title: Assessors
items.description: Adapters that run a tool or import its report as structured evidence.

items.title: Agent integration
items.description: A skill that uses the same specification and CLI as CI.
